configurations_in_fixed_order.reason: Reproduce verified full-context native default, including its historical failed-motion counterexample
Native default posture memory tests sequence reposition sensitivity without changing the frozen hand size

configurations_in_fixed_order.anchors: approved prefix before the note immediately preceding original B02 releasing note
configurations_in_fixed_order.reason: Native fingering hints preserve earlier C1 layout and allow one context-aware tail proposal; not manual note stitching

hand_size_caveat: M is the verified author preset, not measured equality with frozen Rig; no size tuning
ranking: No weighted aggregate or forced winner. First exact-event and overlap legality; then B02 structural change; then whole-context direct reach bounds and known historical failures; then geometry-supported reconfiguration/temporal/black-key risk. Author cost is secondary descriptive evidence only. Unknowns never count as safe.
promising_threshold: An alternative must lower the original B02 structural risk without a demonstrated new hard reach/occupancy contradiction, and provide frozen-Rig static evidence supporting the changed contacts. Unresolved new high-risk transfers can prevent recommendation. Static support cannot certify a continuous trajectory.
static_samples: Fixed 5 fractions [0,.25,.5,.75,1] per legal angle (625 per digit), plus existing legal digit poses from original C1 reference; never optimized or enlarged after results
geometry_phases: Every right-hand onset, onset+35ms or hold midpoint if shorter, and hold midpoint; no new time curves
contact_limits: Existing diagnostic contract: horizontal marker miss <=0.03mm, abs vertical gap <=3mm. Used for static sampled marker evidence, not a full skin contact approval.
reach_bound: MCP fixed-world center and maximal rigid chain length; distance to moving legal surface farther than chain radius+3mm is a necessary fixed-root marker-reach conflict. Conservative singular-value scale bound. Failure to find sampled pose is UNKNOWN, never impossibility.
stop: One run of three native configurations, deduplicate; no custom search, no retries to improve ranking, no motion generation. Preserve historical protection FAIL.
